params.prompt: professional e-commerce product photo of a tan full-grain leather tote bag with visible stitching, full-grain leather with visible pores and stitching, on a seamless light grey background, soft diffused window light from the left, subject filling about 70% of the frame, centered, even margin, sharp focus, high detail, commercial grade, 8k
params.negative_prompt: low resolution, blurry, out of focus, deformed structure, distorted outline, wrong proportions, extra parts, missing parts, melted edges, watermark, logo, text in image, cluttered background, floating without support

notes: 低 denoise 保真：皮具缝线与五金件「一个像素都不能动」（IP-2 纪律）。⚠️ 参考图在离线校验里由**桩 resolver** 提供，不证明素材能被引擎读到
